objects.name: Analytic 2115
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset with both a listening socket on an ICS protocol port and an outbound connection to a non-ICS destination, combined with iptables DNAT rules redirecting ICS protocol port traffic. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
